title: Microsoft Purview: bulk replacement or removal of retention labels (Worldwide)
summary: The roadmap facts, existing role controls and corrected record-label restrictions are supported. The audit checklist nevertheless assumes an event can verify every bulk run, although the documented event covers SharePoint and OneDrive item changes and the bulk action's locations are unknown. The Graph call also needs its API version.
